context: Tanya searches for treasure; party finds recently used utensils and calls for a missing adventurer. Source E3030-E3039 and E3120-E3129 also reviewed.
decisions: Missing adventurer identity and gender unknown; use neutral wording. Imported rows preserved.
provenance: Seventy exact-match imported rows preserved; ten new English translations from Japanese source with adjacent context reviewed.

translations.en: Let's look really hard!
At your feet lay some utensils that someone appeared to have used.
They were still new. Perhaps the missing adventurer dropped them.
I wonder if they're nearby?
Hello? Anyone stranded out there?
Anyone? No one?
It doesn't look like they're nearby.
Or maybe they can't answer?
Are they absent, or simply unable to reply?
Either way, you should search this area thoroughly.
The monsters' presence seems to have grown stronger!
